title: Product Manager (Fully Remote)
descriptionText:
The Role We Need:

PadSplit is hiring a Product Manager to lead our Supply Growth pod within the Marketplace team. This role will define and execute a product roadmap that accelerates new property activations and unlocks scalable supply growth. You will operate at the intersection of product, sales, marketing, and support to build systems and experiences that drive measurable business impact.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a demonstrated track record of shipping features that grow businesses and move core KPIs. You are equally comfortable in user interviews, data analysis, and executive discussions—and you synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear, actionable decisions. You operate with deep ownership, prioritize ruthlessly, and know when to lead from the front versus enabling others to execute.
Here’s What You’ll Be Doing Day-to-Day:
Product Vision: Define and continuously refine the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Supply Growth domain based on data, customer insights, and business priorities.
Stakeholder Alignment: Clearly communicate roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, and progress to cross-functional partners and executive leadership.
Cross-Functional Execution: Partner daily with engineering, design, data, sales, marketing, and support to scope, build, and launch high-impact initiatives.
Roadmap Prioritization: Balance short-term activation wins with long-term platform investments through structured prioritization and clear tradeoff decisions.
User Discovery: Conduct interviews, usability testing, and research to validate hypotheses and ensure a user-centric product approach.
Agile Leadership: Lead sprint rituals including stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and bug triage to ensure high-quality execution.
Performance Analytics: Analyze funnel metrics, activation KPIs, and market data to identify opportunities and measure product impact.
Continuous Iteration: Run experiments, evaluate results, and iterate quickly to improve user experience and core supply growth metrics.
Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful:
Product Experience: 4+ years of product management or comparable experience driving measurable business outcomes.
Marketplace Expertise: Experience in a marketplace business, real estate, investing, or a similarly supply-constrained environment.
Growth Fluency: Strong command of acquisition funnels and KPIs, with the ability to write simple SQL queries to support analysis.
Analytical Rigor: Ability to translate quantitative and qualitative data into clear product decisions and strategic recommendations.
Experimentation Skills: Demonstrated experience scoping, launching, and evaluating product experiments.
Stakeholder Leadership: Proven ability to build alignment and influence across diverse cross-functional teams.
Creative Problem Solving: Capacity to approach problems from multiple angles and generate innovative, practical solutions.
AI Leverage: Experience using—or the ability to quickly ramp on—modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, execution, and analysis.
Results Orientation: High ownership mindset, bias toward action, and commitment to delivering outcomes that serve both customers and the business.
The Interview Process:
Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a human being in the PeopleOps department.
If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Product for forty-five (45) minutes.
If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with a small panel of key stakeholders for one (1) hour. For this interview, a candidate would participate in a mini-case exercise to the panel for discussion.
If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with additional stakeholders for two (2) hours. For this interview, a candidate would participate in a maxi-case exercise to the panel for discussion.
If warranted, then we move to offer!
Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:
Fully remote position - we swear!
Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and a company bonus
National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
Company provided life insurance policy
Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
401(k) plan
Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both eligible birth and non-birth parents
The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis
Compensation is based on the role's scope, nation-wide market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.
Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Atlanta, Georgia, this is a fully remote position. This is a result of our Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn.

Notice to Applicants:

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.

PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Product Manager
descriptionText:
Company Information
Clinical Ink is the global life science company that brings data, technology, and patient science together to unlock clinical discovery. Our deep therapeutic-area expertise, coupled with Direct Data Capture, eCOA, eConsent, telehealth, neurocognitive testing, and digital biomarkers advancement, drive the industry standard for data precision and usher in a new generation of clinical trials. With offices in Philadelphia, PA, Winston Salem, NC, and Iowa City, IA, Clinical Ink is rewriting the clinical development experience.

Job Description
Clinical Ink is seeking a Product Manager to join our Product Management team based remotely across the United States. The Product Manager will lead the design and development of web and mobile applications, ensuring delivery aligns with overall product strategy and business objectives. This role works very closely with Development and Quality resources while defining product requirements, developing use cases, and overseeing design and development milestones. The Product Manager's responsibilities include:
Manage and support web and mobile product design and development and ensure strategy and company deliverables are met by:
Work closely with internal and external/outsourced software development resources continuously throughout the product development lifecycle
Create product requirements documentation
Draft end-user ‘use cases’
Oversee wireframe, low-fidelity, and high-fidelity design development
Manage product development deliverables and milestones
Implement current and future product strategy and efforts
Implement 1-3 year product management strategy (new features, products, etc.) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
Work with cross-functional team members from across the organization to ensure products and features are operationalized
Write and oversee launch strategy for new features/products
Write business cases and ROI for new features/products

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business administration/marketing or related field(s)
5+ years’ experience in product management and/or design
Expertise in web and mobile app development for healthcare/life sciences
Expertise leading product development on both web and mobile platforms
Experience overseeing and participating in 3 or more product development lifecycles
Experience working with agile software development teams
Exceptional communication skills and the ability to communicate to various levels of personnel
Prior project management experience preferred

Additional Information
Clinical ink is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or handicap, or veteran status.
www.clinicalink.com

title: Product Manager II (Mobile)
descriptionText:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America's 100 million homes. We're all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, employees, and Pros grow and succeed together. Leadership is as focused on growing team members' careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros. We also offer:

A generous benefits program that supports the whole you with medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and 401(k)
Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it paid time off
Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs
Monthly tech reimbursements
A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from

Role Overview

Housecall Pro is in the middle of redefining what it means to run a service business from a mobile device. As the lead FinTech Mobile Product Manager, you will be at the center of this evolution, leading a team who are shaping the next wave of FinTech growth at HCP.

As a FinTech Mobile Product Manager II, you are responsible for driving continued expansion and implementing requirements to drive stratospheric growth of HCP Products. You work daily with our engineering and design teams, and other stakeholders to define the right backlog, structures, and frameworks to modernize legacy experiences, introduce net-new capabilities, and push the boundaries of what mobile/AI can unlock for businesses. move us rapidly forward. Our agile product team is a tight-knit group of inspiring individuals that deliver excellently crafted software experiences and rapidly ship new products. You will help guide us along the right path, balancing business and customer toward world-class results.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Our success is their success.

What you do each day:

Identify market opportunities and define product vision and strategy for the mobile experience
Conduct in-depth interviews, surveys, and competitor research to stay ahead of mobile trends
Enhance how our customers are introduced to our products through continuous experimentation and funnel optimization
Collaborate with key cross-functional stakeholders to develop and validate compelling mobile solutions
Co-create event models and user flows to capture insightful data across iOS and Android
Partner with business and go-to-market functions to refine product positioning, pricing, and risk management
Create, update, and communicate the product roadmap to ensure alignment with company objectives
Drive the execution of building features and functionality while maintaining momentum across groups
Create measurement plans to monitor feature adoption and usage post-launch
Rapidly develop product iterations based on data-driven insights and Pro feedback

Qualifications:

3+ total years of experience in product management, 2+ years of experience in mobile product management
Champion AI/mobile-first practices and scalable agile processes to unlock speed, alignment, and craftsmanship
Leads with an AI-first product development process to accelerate and amplify outcomes, specific experience with agentic development and shipping AI products preferred
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
Experience working with mobile 'growth stack' tools (i.e. Amplitude, Segment, Braze, LaunchDarkly)
Deep understanding of mobile product management and design best practices for iOS and Android
Strong knowledge of Product Management methodologies, user experience (UX) principles, and agile development practices
Familiarity with go-to-market commerce enablers (i.e. payments, subscriptions, loyalty programs)

What will help you succeed:

Deep customer empathy and a passion for user experience
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve workflows, streamline execution, or enhance outputs
Strong project management skills with the ability to think and operate at high and low altitudes
Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and analytical skills
Growth mindset that drives you to learn, investigate, and ask the "why"

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.

Housecall Pro's brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

We support more than 40,000 businesses and have over 1,800 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we'd love to hear from you

Housecall Pro celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. #Li-Remote

This role is open to candidates and the expected salary range for this role is $115,000-$135,000. The specific salary for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible to participate in Housecall Pro's equity plan and the following benefits: health care insurance (medical, dental, vision, disability), employee assistance program, 401(K), flexible time off, paid parental leave, tech reimbursement, and other company benefits. Housecall Pro is growing fast and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

Product Manager
At Morgan & Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we're their last
line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. From
attorneys in all 50 states, to client support staff, creative marketing to operations teams,
every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for consumer rights.
Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People.

Summary
At Morgan & Morgan, we're constantly challenging people's idea of what an injury law
firm can be. We are in a unique position as the largest injury firm in the world to
continuously deliver a delightful and consistent client experience for people facing the
greatest challenge of their lives.
We are on a mission to transform how legal services are delivered by leveraging
technology and automation. We build products and experiences for Morgan & Morgan's
clients, employees, and partners. From tools that make it easier for clients to start their
case, using AI to process documents intelligently, bringing transparency to our clients in
an opaque industry, we do it all.
We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team.
This is an in-office position in one of our many offices across the US.

Responsibilities
A Product Manager's duties are to define the vision and roadmap of the product line and
lead a team to ensure successful execution. You will be responsible for delivery of key
product initiatives, determining capacity of the team and balancing workloads, and
setting the metrics for success. This role requires someone who can communicate
complicated solutions clearly, simplify problems into action steps, and lead teams with
charisma and grace. Successful candidates will be responsible for areas including but not
limited to the following:

 Defining the vision for your product and successfully communicating it to senior
leadership and the product team
 Developing the roadmap for your product and defending it
 Leading a team and managing their project pipeline
 Delivering products and features efficiently and executing your vision
 Measuring the success of the product clearly and iterating quickly and effectively

Qualifications
 3+ years of experience in product management, consulting, co-founder or related
technical role
 Jira experience (or similar) - Comfortable with working in a Jira/Agile
environment
 Exceptional interpersonal and teamwork skills
 Ability to multitask in a fast-paced organization
 Flexibility and adaptability to rapid change

Nice to Have:
 Exposure to the legal industry and technology in law firms a plus
 Experience managing a team of direct reports
 Scrum/Agile certifications a plus
 Salesforce experience a plus

#LI-MB1

Benefits

Morgan & Morgan is a leading personal injury law firm dedicated to protecting the people, not the powerful. This success starts with our staff. For full-time employees, we offer an excellent benefits package including medical and dental insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off and paid holidays.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Morgan & Morgan provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

E-Verify

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the I-9 Form.

Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we're still in the midst of exciting product growth — it's a fantastic time to join us. Everything you'll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you've ever worked with, then we hope you'll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey.

About the team & opportunity
*This is a hybrid position located in the Bay Area; the expectation is to go into the San Francisco office 2 times per week.

Calendly is expanding from a scheduling tool into a multi-product platform powered by AI. We are hiring a Staff Product Manager, New Products to lead 0→1 innovation, focusing on creating new product experiences that transform how solopreneurs and small businesses run and grow their business.

This is a highly entrepreneurial, high-visibility, high-autonomy role for a PM who thrives in ambiguous spaces, partners well with leadership, and loves building new product lines from scratch.

What's Great About Working on Calendly's Product Team

We design seamless product experiences that delight our customers. Calendly takes the work out of scheduling so our customers have more time to focus on what matters most. Millions of people worldwide use our software every day — with thousands more signing up daily.

As a Staff Product Manager, New Products, you'll have the rare opportunity to shape the future of Calendly's multi-product strategy. This role is focused on incubating and validating new 0-to-1 product ideas, with many of these ideas leveraging the power of AI. You'll explore bold concepts, test hypotheses quickly, and partner closely with engineering and design to bring new solutions to life.

Your Mission

Build the next generation of Calendly products. Your charter is to identify, incubate, and scale new product experiences that:

Extend Calendly's value beyond scheduling into new product lines powered by AI
Drive retention, and new revenue
Deliver net-new value that delights solopreneurs and small businesses
Leverage AI to create experiences that feel intelligent, proactive, and effortless

You will own discovery, strategy, launch, and lifecycle ownership — including defining and delivering the success metrics for activation, adoption, revenue expansion, and customer satisfaction.

A Day in the Life

This position reports to our Chief Product Officer. You'll thrive in an environment where creativity and experimentation are encouraged, and where speed matters as much as precision.

On a typical day, you will:

Lead discovery and validation of new product ideas, including rapid prototyping and customer testing
Explore how AI can power new experiences across scheduling, meetings and beyond
Collaborate with R&D (Engineering, Design, Research) to build MVPs and experiments that unlock high-potential opportunities
Partner with leadership to align new initiatives with Calendly's long-term multi-product vision
Define success metrics and run experiments to quickly evaluate product-market fit
What Makes This a True 0→1 Role

You will:

Define entirely new product experiences
Build rapid prototypes and Minimum Delightful Products
Validate problems, define user segments, and drive upgrades
Create the product narrative, roadmap, and long-term strategy
Own the execution path from concept → beta → GA → scale
Influence the future of Calendly's evolution

This is not optimization work — this is category creation.

AI + LLM Technologies You'll Leverage

You will have access to Calendly's rapidly evolving AI Platform and modern LLM capabilities, including:

LLM-powered contextual reasoning (OpenAI + future models)
Evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, accuracy, and reliability across features
AI tools for prototyping to rapidly iterate on UI designs
Agentic tasks and workflows
AI-assisted generation, summarization, and relationship insights

Build one of Calendly's next-generation product lines

title: Technical Product Manager
descriptionText:
Technical Product Manager

San Francisco, CA

About us

Metriport is an open-source data intelligence platform that helps healthcare organizations access and exchange patient data in real-time. We integrate with all major US healthcare IT systems and tap into comprehensive medical data for 300+ million individuals.

We've found product-market fit with multi-million ARR, 100+ customers (including Amazon, Strive Health, and Weight Watchers), backing from top VCs, and years of runway. We're ready to scale. We're a tight-knit, high-performing team of mostly former founders (including YC alumni). We're engineering-heavy, operate with minimal bureaucracy and high autonomy, and hire based on competence, not prestige. We push hard—founders work six days a week from our SF office—but give everyone freedom to craft their schedule. We measure output and we're committed to sustainable intensity.

The Role

As a Technical PM at Metriport, you’ll be ensuring solutions are both valuable to customers and viable for the business, requiring deep knowledge of business constraints, user engagement data, industry trends, and the competitive landscape.

This role requires a highly collaborative individual contributor who drives consistent innovation by working closely with different parts of the organization to discover and deliver effective solutions. While empowered to determine the best approach, you are held accountable for achieving measurable results, influencing stakeholders and executives through data and sound logic to ensure success beyond mere delivery.

In the first few months, you’ll be working closely with the founders and the wider team to define and execute the product roadmap. You’ll be responsible for:

Product Definition: Working with founders and customers to translate high-level vision into detailed, actionable product specifications for the engineering team.

Execution: Managing the product lifecycle from ideation through development, launch, and iteration, ensuring high quality and timely delivery.

Technical Deep Dives: Acquiring and maintaining a deep understanding of the product's technical aspects, including API design, data models, and integration requirements.

Domain Expertise: Quickly ramping up to expert-level domain knowledge in healthcare interoperability and data exchange, including relevant technical standards.

Requirements

Experience: 4+ years working on software products as either a product manager, product designer, engineer, data analyst, data scientist, or user researcher.

Core Competency: Ability to learn multiple functional areas of business – engineering, design, finance, sales, or marketing.

Problem Solving: Can work through hard problems to figure out solutions with many constraints, using sound judgement to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative.

Collaborative: Proven ability to engage with engineering, design, sales, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship.

Ambiguity Tolerance: You thrive in fast-paced environments and know how to drive projects to completion without a playbook.

Location: Based in San Francisco (or willing to relocate). We have an office the team works 6 days a week out of.

The "Metriport" Mindset: Low ego, high ownership. You ask "Why can't this be done in 3 days?" instead of 3 weeks.

Bonus Points

Domain: Experience in the Healthcare IT or Healthtech space.

Engineering Experience: Direct contribution to APIs

AI Products: Experience building AI-driven products.

Benefits

Competitive equity + compensation package

Full family Platinum health insurance, dental, and vision coverage

401(k) retirement plan + matching

Flexible work from home or in-office

Healthy lunches complimentary when in-office (and breakfast + dinners as needed)

Quarterly company off-sites with the team

MacBook provided by us

Unlimited PTO (we work hard, but trust you to take time you need to be at your best) '

Metriport provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

descriptionText:
Description

Project Canary is a climate technology company offering an enterprise data platform that helps energy companies improve and report on their emissions footprint. Project Canary builds high-fidelity sensors, ingests data from various other technologies and sources, and leverages proprietary analytics and models to deliver insights that operators can act on to reduce emissions. The data-driven technology enables energy operators to stop leaks faster, reduce risk, streamline reporting, and differentiate their operations for key stakeholders.

We’re looking for a driven, organized, and self-sufficient Product Manager to help keep our development engine running smoothly across a growing suite of products. This role is built for someone who likes momentum: you’ll own day-to-day roadmap execution, run a tight delivery process, and help ship high-quality releases across customer-facing desktop and mobile applications, APIs, and data integrations.

You’ll report to the Director of Product and partner closely with our team of engineers working across multiple product areas. Success in this role looks like consistent delivery, clear requirements, aligned stakeholders, and launches that feel calm and coordinated, even when priorities shift.

What You’ll Do

Own execution across multiple products
Jump between product areas as priorities change, getting up to speed quickly and keeping work moving.
Translate customer and internal input into clear product insights and next steps.
Drive delivery and team process
Document product requirements with engineering, including crisp scope and acceptance criteria.
Plan, prioritize, and keep the team organized: clean backlog, clear priorities, strong weekly rhythm.
Run agile ceremonies and enforce lightweight, effective process.
Ship high-quality releases
Lead product acceptance testing and coordinate launches for major releases.
Write release notes and launch communications, ensure stakeholders know what’s shipping and when.
Maintain launch readiness (testing, checklists, dependencies, handoffs).
Enable teams and customers
Create and maintain training and enablement materials for internal teams and customers.
Develop strong product fluency across our platform and customer workflows.
Why It Matters
This role is central to how we deliver product value. You’ll be the person who makes sure priorities turn into completed work while helping engineering stay focused, helping the org stay aligned, and helping customers feel continuous improvement in the product.
If you want to be hands-on, ship frequently, and grow quickly in a role with real ownership, we’d love to meet you.

Who This Role Fits

This role is a strong match if you’re the kind of PM who:
Thrives with a high degree of ownership, translating high-level direction into clear, actionable plans.
Moves comfortably across multiple products, keeping priorities clear even as context shifts.
Adapts quickly in a fast-paced environment while keeping teams aligned and organized.
Introduces practical structure and scalable processes that support efficient product development.
Communicates clearly and proactively so decisions and priorities stay visible and aligned.
Education and experience:
3-5 years of experience on a software product team as a product manager, product owner, or similar role.
Experience being customer facing and synthesizing customer feedback into clear problem definition.
Professional writing experience of release notes, technical documentation, knowledge base articles, or something similar.
Adaptability to manage a wide range of projects within our product suite.
A basic understanding of agile software development processes.
Nice to haves:
Experience in the utility, oil & gas, environmental services, or any related industry.
Experience at an early stage start-up.
Previous use of a product tools such as Jira, Pendo, Google Analytics, or Heap or any business analytics tools like PowerBI or Spotfire.
Knowledge of user experience design, especially any design tools such as Figma.

title: Technical Product Manager
descriptionText:
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Technical Product Manager to join our team. This role will focus on driving the strategy, development, and delivery of our software solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer needs. The Technical Product Manager will work closely with cross-functional teams to bring new features and enhancements to life.

The Technical Product Manager will work especially closely with our Data Engineering & Development teams. This individual will act as the product resource focused on building and enhancing integrations with key platforms. The Technical Product Manager will work closely with engineering, product, QA, and business stakeholders to drive integration projects from ideation to execution, ensuring each integration aligns with business objectives and client needs.

Key Responsibilities:

Integration Strategy & Planning:
Collaborate with Product leadership and cross-functional teams to contribute to a roadmap that incorporates integrations, AI capabilities, and internal tooling that align with Ludi’s strategic objectives.
Develop and execute a strategy to standardize and productize integrations for scalable growth, reducing reliance on custom one-off solutions.
Product Development:
Own the product lifecycle for integrations & complex technical product capabilities, from requirements gathering and technical feasibility to launch and support.
Partner closely with the integration IT Project Manager to proactively identify opportunities to standardize and productize automations and integration solutions
Maintain and prioritize a backlog of integration features and enhancements based on business impact and customer feedback.
Manage and prioritize project scope, ensuring alignment with company goals and customer priorities.
Define and document product requirements and write user stories to ensure engineering has clear requirements and business context for value
Develop user and data flows, process maps, and wireframes to guide design and development.
Develop detailed versioning plans for delivering value iteratively and incrementally
Monitor development progress, identify risks, and ensure timely delivery of features.
Cross-functional Collaboration:
Maintain continuous alignment with Customer Success on evolving integration and automation needs, gaps, and capabilities.
Collaborate with external partners and vendors to align on integration needs and technical specifications.
Partner closely with engineering, QA, and project management teams to ensure integration features and capabilities are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
Customer-Centric Focus:
Act as a liaison with clients and internal stakeholders and gather feedback to continuously enhance integration solutions.
Educate clients on integration capabilities, serving as a product ambassador to drive adoption and maximize client satisfaction.
What We’re Looking For
We’re seeking a systems thinker who thrives in fast-paced, complex environments. The ideal individual is energized by challenge and ambiguity and excels at balancing multiple priorities simultaneously. You must be highly adaptable, capable of maintaining focus and delivering high-quality work amidst shifting demands and frequent distractions.

Success in this role requires:
Exceptional organizational skills and an ability to juggle competing priorities with poise and efficiency.
A calm, solutions-oriented mindset when faced with high volume and tight deadlines.
Strong multitasking skills and the ability to stay laser-focused in an environment where interruptions are common and context-switching is frequent.
A high tolerance for ambiguity and a proactive approach to problem-solving in a dynamic setting.
Comfort translating technical requirements to business stakeholders, vendors, and customers
Willingness and ability to embrace AI to empower and enable productivity in your own work, but also to imagine how we can leverage it to deliver greater value to our internal partners and external customers
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of product management experience, preferably in a SaaS environment or in industries focused on integrations with EHRs, ERPs, scheduling systems, or contract management systems.
Strong technical aptitude with experience in API-based integrations and a solid understanding of data exchange protocols (e.g., HL7, FHIR for healthcare; REST, SOAP).
Proven track record of managing integration projects from concept through release.
Experience working with AI tools, both for your own work and building AI-integrated product capabilities
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Must be able to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, prioritize workload effectively, and thrive in a complex environment.
Experience with modern product management methodologies.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of healthcare industry standards and compliance requirements, particularly related to EHRs and healthcare data exchange.
This is a remote position, candidates must be located within the United States.

title: Product Manager
descriptionText:
Overview

As a Product Manager at Phia, you’ll drive execution for user-facing product features across the platform. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data to define requirements, prioritize work, and ship features from concept through launch and iteration. You’ll be responsible for translating product goals into clear specs, managing day-to-day execution, and using data and user feedback to guide decisions. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys operating close to the build, moving quickly, and delivering measurable product outcomes.

About Phia

Phia is building the AI layer that connects consumers and brands, powering a personalized shopping agent that translates real-time consumer intent into trusted product discovery. Launched in April 2025, Phia has surpassed 1 million users in under a year and partnered with 6,200+ retail brands, representing billions in annual gross merchandise volume. Each month, Phia drives millions of dollars in sales for brands and has achieved 11× revenue growth since launch, with partners seeing higher conversion rates, stronger new customer acquisition, increased average order value, and significantly reduced return rates.

Phia’s core experience is an AI shopping agent embedded directly within users’ natural shopping flow, delivering real-time insights that help users make smarter, more confident purchase decisions.

Phia is a small, high-ownership team building at startup speed. If you want to ship at high velocity, solve complex problems in consumer AI and commerce, and have clear ownership from day one, this is the place to do it.

What You Own

Drive day-to-day execution of product features from requirements through launch

Write clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria

Partner closely with Engineering and Design to scope, prioritize, and deliver work on schedule

Manage product backlogs, tradeoffs, and iteration plans

Use data, metrics, and user feedback to evaluate feature performance and inform next steps

Coordinate launches and communicate updates to cross-functional stakeholders

Qualifications

1–3+ years of experience in product management, product operations, or a related role

Experience working closely with engineering teams to ship software products

Strong ability to translate product goals into clear, actionable requirements

Comfort using data and metrics to support product decisions

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in fast-paced environments

Clear communicator with a bias toward execution and ownership

Compensation Range: $170K - $210K

title: Product Manager - Platform
descriptionText:
About Us
Here at BusRight, we say that Product is our heart — so much so that our Product Team is home to one of our two cofounders (CPO), a founding team member (now Head of Product), and has started growing a team of Product Managers. We’re continuing to grow this tight-knit, high-impact team with another critical role that will help shape the future of our platform and expand the reach of our product suite.

We are seeking a dedicated, self-driven, transformative individual to help us bring modern technology to users of all levels of sophistication in education transportation through our innovative suite of mobile and web apps. As a Product Manager - Platform, you’ll play one of the most critical roles in our company. You’ll be the glue between the voice of the customer and our engineering team, ensuring that every step we take aligns with our mission and values.

Role Overview
As Product Manager, you will be the connective tissue of the company, collaborating with all functional areas including sales, engineering, product, design, and strategy.

At BusRight, we believe our product speaks for itself and is the clearest, most cogent way to market the company. The Product Manager is a key enabler in telling the story of our product.

Ensure that every decision in the company is aligned to the implications of the data about the product; track product engagement and performance metrics and keep everyone excited in the story it tells.
Articulate and implement customer engagement opportunities like focus groups, Design Partner conversations, and Early Access programs.
Serve as a product-focused mentor, when needed, for the Engineering team including periodically coding proofs of concept for new ideas, and designing use cases for testing.

Platform Focus
We’re looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of the underlying platform—systems, infrastructure, and internal tooling—that supports every layer of BusRight’s multi-product suite.

In this role, you’ll:

We’re looking for a Product Manager - Platform to lead the systems, infrastructure, and internal tooling that power every part of BusRight’s multi-product suite. You’ll focus on creating the connective tissue that ensures our features are integrated, scalable, and consistently excellent and enable the rest of the team to build faster and smarter.
You’ll work closely with Engineering to build scalable, performant, and resilient infrastructure that powers everything from routing to real-time bus tracking, ensuring all parts of our multi product suite are deeply integrated and have compounding value. Cross feature integration, reusable infrastructure and user experience familiarity across our suite is key.
Join a tight-knit product team alongside Core and Growth PMs, working cross-functionally to shape the full BusRight platform.

Your Day-To-Day

Own areas of our product: define their roadmap collaboratively with Product team peers and serve as the company-wide institutional knowledge on the “why” as it relates to product features and decisions.
Grow our product suite into a new customer segment by designing and implementing product onboarding and performance-related product features.
Lead and participate in monthly agile ceremonies, fostering clear communication, decision-making, and collaboration within our self-organizing engineering and design teams.
Oversee successful product launches, ensuring timelines, quality, and stakeholder alignment, while tracking post-launch performance, gathering user feedback, and driving iterative improvements to meet company goals.
Obsess with the entire product experience and an understanding of how each user receives value from BusRight.
Meet with customers and work closely with our customer success efforts to identify and support collaboration opportunities for research and testing. Occasionally travel to customer sites across the country to gather insights, build relationships, and ensure our product meets their needs and expectations.
Provide our sales team with hand-off for new features and occasionally join prospect calls for research and roadmap alignment purposes.

Requirements

About You

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, Business, Marketing or a related field or equivalent work experience
3–4 years experience in product management or related experience, preferably in a startup or fast-paced environment
Proven experience in establishing and refining product development processes to drive efficiency and deliver successful outcomes
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus across diverse stakeholders
Solid experience working with a web and/or mobile-based tech stack or experience with Agile development methodologies
Outstanding critical listening skills with the ability to synthesize the communications of others clearly
Embodies the down-to-earth nature of our industry, is deeply passionate about education, and thrives in a collaborative, mission-driven environment. Embody our values

SmartRent (NYSE: SMRT) is revolutionizing how people live and work with the industry's only end-to-end platform designed for the rental housing industry. By uniting purpose-built software, integrated hardware and full implementation and support in one ecosystem, we help owners and operators simplify operations, cut costs and deliver exceptional resident experiences. You will be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible, while sharing our healthy obsession for quality and attention to detail. CENTEGIX® is the industry leader in wearable safety technology for healthcare, education, government, and commercial workplaces with nearly 800,000 badges in use. We are seeking a Product Manager who is passionate about building internal-facing products that power critical customer journeys. In this role, you will own the products that support customers from purchase through successful use, defining the roadmap for onboarding, implementation, and post-purchase systems used across our organization.

You will lead product discovery and decision-making, represent customer and operator needs, and partner closely with Engineering and Product Design to build scalable, intuitive software solutions that accelerate time-to-value for both customers and internal teams.

Own the product vision and roadmap for customer onboarding and implementation software platforms, focusing on scalability, consistency, and time-to-launch.
Lead product discovery with internal users and stakeholders, synthesizing qualitative feedback and quantitative data to identify high-impact product opportunities.
Translate user needs and business goals into clear product requirements, user stories, and success criteria for software systems and workflows.
Partner closely with Engineering and Product Design to break down complex configuration and deployment needs into intuitive, user-centered experiences.
Drive prioritization decisions based on customer impact, technical feasibility, and strategic alignment.
Communicate product direction, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations.
Define and track product success metrics, using insights to guide iteration and continuous improvement.
Support the rollout and adoption of new capabilities, ensuring solutions are usable, reliable, and scalable in real-world environments.

5+ years of Product Management experience, with a strong focus on building and scaling software products.
Experience owning products that support complex user journeys, such as, implementation or post-purchase workflows.
Familiarity with products that integrate software and physical systems is a plus, with the ability to reason through technical and operational constraints.
Proven ability to partner effectively with Engineering and Product Design to deliver high-quality, user-centered software solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to decompose ambiguous problems into clear product decisions and outcomes.
Comfort operating in a high-growth environment with evolving priorities and imperfect information.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate product strategy and tradeoffs.
A data-informed approach to roadmap planning, prioritization, and iteration.
Travel is not a core requirement for this role, though occasional travel may be needed for internal meetings or industry events.

Remote first work environment; we offer workplace flexibility
Participation in company wide discretionary bonus
Fifteen days of PTO plus twelve company holidays
Three days of paid Sick Leave and one floating holiday
Monthly device(s) reimbursement
Up to $2500/year reimbursement for eligible education expenses
We offer a range of Healthcare plans to meet your needs (medical, dental, vision)
401(k) Plan with 4% employer contribution to help you plan for the future
Employee Referral Bonus
Charitable Program Match

title: Product Manager
descriptionText:
Product Manager

About the Role
We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape the future of Kuali’s core product offerings.

As a Product Manager, you will understand the unique needs of faculty, administrators, and staff and translate those insights into thoughtful product direction. You will lead cross-functional teams, collaborate across Kuali, and deliver iterative value to our higher education customers.

This role can be remote, or in our Lehi, UT office

Who are we?
Kuali builds software solutions for higher education. We help our customers — colleges and universities — focus on providing a fantastic education to students by decreasing their administrative costs. We work in a competitive space, ripe for innovation, with users ready to be delighted. We are poised for high growth.

Our Culture
As a company, we are guided by our cultural values:
Iterate to evolve
Cultivate openness
Act with accountability
Assume the best
Practice humility
Deliver amazing experiences
Drive outcomes
At Kuali, we learn from and teach each other, we practice transparency and empathy, we delight in delivering value to our customers, and we WIN!

We’ve embraced distributed work for years—it’s part of who we are. Many of our employees work remotely across the U.S., from Massachusetts to Seattle, while others collaborate in person at our office locations. We’re intentional about creating a healthy, connected culture no matter where you work.

What you’ll be responsible for
Developing a deep understanding of customers and users — and the workflows they rely on — to inform product strategy, design, and development.
Defining, planning, and prioritizing product features and initiatives to support customer needs, business objectives, and long-term product vision.
Leading and motivating an uncommonly talented and passionate team of designers and developers to deliver value iteratively.
Partnering with marketing to help shape product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market efforts that drive awareness and demand.
Partnering with sales to respond to RFPs and helping prospective customers understand current product capabilities and our product roadmap.
Learning from, and educating others about, competitor products and evolving regulations in the research administration space.
Helping customers be successful in their rollouts, adoption, and continued use of our products.
About you
We are looking for an enthusiastic team player who will contribute to a team culture built on trust and mutual respect. We believe the best results are achieved by teams who represent a broad range of ideas and perspectives. We value employees with diverse backgrounds and experiences. You may be a great fit for this role if:
You align with Kuali’s values: You are excited to contribute to an environment that reflects them.
You are detail-oriented: You have an amazing attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
You are an amazing communicator: You are a great listener and your communication is clear, concise, and tailored to your audience. You possess strong editing skills.
You are organized, communicative, and accountable: You have excellent organization and prioritization skills. You own your role entirely, while being open to feedback, suggestions, edits, and new ideas.
You are self-motivated and eager to grow: You have a thirst for knowledge, especially within higher education. You are proactive and your enthusiasm shows.
You are resourceful and solution-oriented: When faced with a problem, you work to solve it with tact, persistence, and urgency.
You are adaptable and curious: You know how to gather information from multiple sources — customers, teammates, and competitors — and synthesize it into a clear direction. You adapt well to different people and personalities.
You multitask effectively: You’re comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines, even when timelines shift.
You are team-oriented and thrive in remote environments: You love being helpful and supportive, and you thrive on the successes of the team. You’re comfortable being part of a fully remote team, and you maintain a home working environment that sets you up for success.
We'd be delighted if you bring experience with:
Working at a SaaS company that provides solutions for higher education.
Partnering with higher education institutions or other organizations that rely on State or Federal funding and/or to simplify complex academic workflows.
Driving adoption of enterprise software across diverse stakeholders (faculty, administrators, compliance officers).
Translating complex regulatory requirements into user-friendly product designs.
Leading usability studies or customer research that shaped product direction.
We have two positions available within Kuali, we understand these are large areas of expertise and we do not expect you to be an expert in both! Please don’t hesitate to apply if either category fits your skillset.

Research
Research administration systems, grant management platforms, or compliance-focused software.
Working in a Grant Management or Compliance office.
Academic Operations
Student information systems (SIS), curriculum management platforms, or accreditation tools.
Designing or supporting systems that improve faculty, staff, and student experiences.
Perks
Flexible remote work with no expectation of returning to an office setting
A truly exceptional benefits package including full premium coverage for employee and dependent medical and dental care
401(k) matching
Paid Maternity/Parental leave
Flexible PTO — no accrual limits, no ‘use it or lose it.’ Just work with your manager to make sure the team’s covered, and take the time you need to recharge.
Encouragement and support in learning and improving your skill-sets
A recognition platform to reward your contributions with meaningful incentives
Company retreats to connect, recharge, and collaborate
Kuali has been voted a top place to work for 9 years in a row by the Salt Lake Tribune. In 2024 TIME Magazine honored us by naming Kuali to their list of the World’s Top EdTech Companies, ranking us #99 overall and #37 in the US.

At Kuali, we embrace diversity and inclusion at every level. We value and respect individuals from all backgrounds, recognizing that a rich tapestry of experiences and perspectives fuels our success as a company and enriches our collective human experience.

title: Product Manager
descriptionText:
Overview:

This position is within the Product Management division, which is accountable for the success of our software solutions by working cross-functionally with teams that develop, market, sell and support them.

Product Managers will help execute the product strategy by working closely with user experience, development squads and product strategy leaders to ensure that quality products are released on time. They own and manage detailed requirements and communicate through the agile development tools. They develop prioritized roadmaps with incremental releases and continuously keep internal and external stakeholders informed of the progress. They pursue user-centered design and evaluate work-in-progress features with user experience analysts to ensure delightful user experiences.

Responsibilities:

What You’ll Be Doing

Product Definition

Embrace the agile product development process adopted by ConstructConnect: Think It! Build It! Ship It! Tweak It!
Actively participate in “design thinking” exercises to help define identified product opportunities and find solutions.
Leverage Voice of the Customer, and Voice of the Organization, to solve problems at hand and articulate customer feedback to agile project teams.
At the end of Think It!, break down features into incremental deliverables (stories) and collaborate with UX/UI teams to deliver appropriate design packages
Articulate new feature definition very detailed and work with agile project teams to develop achievable product roadmap and timelines.

Business Planning

Assist Product Strategy managers in developing product OKRs that are aligned with business strategy.
Track and report product OKR and other product/team metrics on a regular basis.

Product Planning

Breakdown high level product requirements and collaborate with product leaders and user experience teams to define incremental releases.
Manage feature development and enhancements from concept through design to tactical execution.
Define the product release roadmap for at least 2 quarters and communicate regularly to stakeholders throughout the business
Influence Product Strategy Managers on product (or product line) roadmaps with knowledge of current product and technical capabilities.

Product Delivery

Collaborate with scrum master, agile teams and other key project stakeholders to ensure proper deliverables.
Work with UX, Product Strategy managers to document key customer value and communicate to the GTM teams.
Participate in evangelizing product’s new features internally and externally.

Technical Skills

Be a product expert and go-to person on the new products and services
Keep abreast of internal and external technologies relevant to our current/future needs and tied to product growth.

Skill Levels:

Leadership

Will work individually and occasionally manage the work of others depending on the position level. This may be internal or external resources – including other technical product managers.
Works with one or more scrum teams to drive strategy and ensure progress of a product or product line.
Works with UX/UI colleagues to detail and grooms the features along with scrum team members.
Communicates regularly product status of new feature ideations and VOC results to scrum teams
Helps influence Product Strategy Leader and other colleagues on product direction.
Sets direction and influences messaging for a product during product releases.
Influences peers (BA/UX/Arch/Dev) to arrive at coordinated direction for timely execution and manages scope and quality.
Works with other scrum teams to manage the dependencies.
Influences leadership in resource decisions.
Influences product line priorities and GTM and business priorities.

Breadth

Frequently interacts with peer groups, SMEs, and UX colleagues to acquire product knowledge.
Exhibits sufficient knowledge of cloud-based software components to help accelerate ConstructConnect backlog grooming.
Regularly interacts often with customers and captures/clarifies detailed requirements.
Exhibits great strong knowledge of features being built and becomes a key point person for other internal stakeholders.
Influences products strategy in shaping the product line direction. Focusses on a product/product line but generally cognizant of and influences other products too.
Regularly interacts with leadership team, key stakeholders to help/influence key decisions.

Complex Thinking

Exercises judgement by evaluating a variety of factors, including business goals, customer business objectives, and industry/competitive trends, to guide/influence development of multiple products.

Communication

Presents UX intent of the designs for the new features.
Manages expectations with internal stakeholders on short term roadmaps.
Builds strong internal partnership with GTM teams and participates in communicating with GTM members both customer value and upcoming roadmaps.
Informs frequently development squads of roadmaps and VOC findings.
Articulates product vision to customers focusing on competitive separation.
Frequently communicates and advocates for product roadmaps to internal leadership and stakeholders.
Communicates key customer value to GTM teams, timely and frequently.
Acts as the primary contact for GTM members, ARB and development squads.

This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform

Qualifications:

What You Bring to the Team

descriptionText:
Lucid Software is the leader in visual collaboration, helping teams see and build the future from idea to reality. Our products, business, and workplace culture have received numerous awards, such as being named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology. Lucid is a hybrid workplace, allowing employees to work remotely, from one of our offices, or a combination of the two depending on the needs of the role and team. At Lucid, we hold true to our core values of teamwork over ego, innovation in everything we do, individual empowerment, initiative, and ownership, and passion and excellence in every area. We value diversity and are dedicated to creating an environment that is respectful and inclusive for everyone.

We are looking for a rockstar Product Manager that will have an impact on our Search and Change Management teams to enable our customers (individuals to enterprises) to quickly engage in Lucid where they can collaborate, generate ideas, and create actionable business decisions. You will be joining a vibrant team of PMs, UX Designers, Engineers and QA Specialists that work on everything from high-value, tailored solutions for specific personas; to the user experience of working with data and diagrams together; to the innovative technical platform that makes it all possible. Are you a natural mentor and a great teammate? Do you have a passion for elegant solutions and user experiences? Do you have the technical skills to understand search systems at scale? Are you drawn to work that is different every single day? If this is you, let's talk!

Responsibilities:

Work closely with UX, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and other Product teams
Become an expert in our customers, their motivations, goals, and needs
Deliver on key business outcomes measured by top level business metrics
Own product features and/or themes through their creative cycle: ideation, specification, development, release, analysis, and iteration
Perform qualitative and quantitative research to discover feature ideas and validate them before development
Work closely with UI/UX designers to ensure an excellent user experience in our product
Work with engineers to help guide feature development
Effectively leveraging metrics to understand usage patterns and the effectiveness of features using quantitative analysis to find opportunities for optimization
Effectively plan and prioritize work across multiple projects, and communicate priority to relevant stakeholders
Be responsible for affecting key performance indicators
Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree
3-5 years of software Product Management experience
Track record of improving core business and product metrics, especially in B2B SaaS environments
Ability to de-risk: can be creative and come up with ways to validate hypotheses quickly
Ability to talk with anyone from engineers to enterprise sales reps, solution engineers, executive-level customers, internal stakeholders, and end users, each in their own language
Ability to understand and discuss technical trade-offs (e.g., Precision vs. Recall, or Latency vs. Feature Richness).
Understand how to create simple and intuitive user experiences
Excellent working relationship with engineering and UX
Proven ability to take feedback and learn fast

Preferred Qualifications:

Strong eye for polish, design, and brand within a product
Experience with document-centric solutions within the Software as a Service (SaaS) domain
Search Domain Expertise with experience with Elasticsearch and or OpenSearch
Experience working with SaaS tools administrators
Experience with rapid prototyping and learning techniques, including AB/multivariate testing
Strong understanding of digital products and productivity workflow

descriptionText:
Clipbook’s mission: reinvent how leaders listen to and engage the world.

We are the vertical AI category leader for the $100 billion communications, public relations, and public affairs industries.

Since 2023, we have quietly grown into the largest AI company in this segment. We are backed by leading investors in the segment - including Mark Cuban, who co-led our seed round.

A bit more about us:

We bootstrapped to our first million in ARR and hit profitability before raising our $3.3 million seed round this year.

We’re currently growing >10% month-over-month and on track to >3x ARR this year.

We’re working with 200+ clients including the Boston Consulting Group, Weber Shandwick, the Gates Foundation, and dozens of government agencies across the country.

We will raise our Series A in early 2026.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Roadmap & Strategy: Develop and communicate a clear product vision and roadmap, prioritizing features and initiatives based on customer needs & business goals; collaborate with stakeholders to align the product roadmap with organizational objectives.; understand our existing and future customer needs through interviews, A/B testing, and conversations to execute on high impact feature development.

Customer Research & Engagement: Conduct customer interviews, surveys, and usability studies to gather insights and feedback; analyze customer needs and translate them into actionable requirements and user stories.

Agile Product Development: Partner with & lead our technical investments (drive overall strategy, daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives; etc.); lead product design to create intuitive and user-friendly interfaces; create and iterate upon UI/UX designs to ensure alignment with product goals.

Qualifications:

Minimum ~3 years experience in a product role, preferably in an early-stage business. Ideally more. But still ready for a fast-paced and execution-forward environment.

Exceptional execution capabilities, scrappiness, communication, and collaboration skills.

Passion for innovation in artificial intelligence.

Hands-on experience with SCRUM or other agile methodologies.

Preferred Skills:

Track record of early-stage experience (building a product from the ground up, from prototyping to MVP to scaled launch).

What We Offer:

Competitive salary with significant equity outlay.

Comprehensive full benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k, unlimited book budget, etc.).

A profitably- and rapidly-growing startup with commercial rigor at its core.

A smart, hard working, and resourceful team who is passionate, driven, and excited.

A product with incredibly commercial velocity generating $M’s in revenue.

Nimble & rapid execution - with the chance to really make a high-leverage impact on product strategy & investments.

descriptionText:
About Percent

Percent is unlocking private credit and providing unparalleled access through its modern marketplace, empowering investors, borrowers, and managers with innovative technology to increase the speed and frequency of transactions at a fraction of the cost. The company's core infrastructure delivers public market efficiencies to the analog private credit market by powering the sourcing, structuring, syndication, surveillance and servicing of private credit transactions from beginning to end. Founded in 2018, Percent's platform is becoming the market standard for asset-based and corporate lending, powering over $2 billion in transaction volume in a multi-trillion-dollar private credit industry.

The Role

We are seeking a talented product manager to be a driving force behind our mission to modernize the private credit market. In this role, you won't just manage a product; you'll own and shape the core features of our platform. You will be a catalyst for innovation, responsible for defining the product vision, building a roadmap, and leading the end-to-end execution to deliver transformative features that bring transparency and efficiency to this historically opaque market.

Responsibilities
Product strategy and vision: Develop and articulate a clear product strategy and vision for your areas of the platform
Roadmap: Build and maintain a roadmap, prioritizing features and initiatives to achieve business objectives
Prioritization: Define, prioritize, and manage the backlog, ensuring a focus on the most impactful features
Product execution: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and requirements gathering to stories, specifications and wireframes through the development cycle to launch, adoption, and ongoing iteration
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders, other product managers, design, engineering, and QA to deliver
Communication: Clearly communicate updates, timelines, and results to internal and external stakeholders; manage issues and escalation
User and market feedback: Analyze market trends, leverage product analytics and direct user feedback to inform product decisions and identify new opportunities
Teamwork: Contribute to a team of passionate product managers and ensure a cohesive experience across the platform
Requirements
A passion for developing and delivering market-leading products that solve complex problems in financial services
5-10 years of experience as a fintech pm with a strong understanding of financial markets, particularly private credit, debt capital markets, or alternative investments
Demonstrated ability to manage the entire product lifecycle
Experience working with engineering teams and agile methodologies
Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Strong organization and project management skills with relentless focus on the details
Self-motivated team player able to work independently in a fast-paced environment
Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Figma
Bachelor's degree in an engineering or business related field preferred
Benefits
Competitive base salary and equity compensation
Hybrid work environment in NYC
Commuter stipend
Paid vacation days
100% paid medical coverage for employee/family
Dental & vision insurance
401(k)

The pay range for this role is $125,000 - 175,000 per year dependent on multiple factors, which may include the successful candidate's skills, experience and other qualifications.

If you enjoy running projects from concept to completion, collaborating with contractors, reporting on energy savings, and seeing your work improve real-world facilities, this role offers the opportunity to make an impact across critical USPS operations nationwide .

This position is ideal for professionals with experience in architecture, engineering, energy/environmental management, or construction management who can confidently balance technical oversight and project coordination.

You’ll work on facility upgrades, repairs, and system improvements that keep USPS facilities running efficiently and safely.

Why this role stands out:
• Work on meaningful infrastructure projects supporting a national organization
• Build experience managing diverse facility improvement initiatives
• Join a stable federal contractor supporting long-term programs
• Opportunity to grow your project leadership skills

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Sr Product Manager
descriptionText:
About MCIM

MCIM – The Data Center Operating System (DCOS) is a platform that simplifies the complexities of managing a data center by bringing all functions and locations under one intuitive dashboard.

MCIM started with a commission from a Fortune 100 financial institution to create a cloud computing solution for managing their global critical facilities. The team developed the MCIM platform based on the lessons learned from that project.

Today, MCIM is utilized by Fortune 100 and 500 companies in over 94 countries worldwide. This world-class solution is continuously improved through collaboration with users and industry organizations like The Uptime Institute.

Senior Product Manager - MCIM Application

About the Role

As Senior Product Manager, you will play a critical role in shaping the evolution of this platform and the company’s growth. You will define strategic capabilities, prioritize roadmap investments, and ensure we deliver high-impact solutions that improve reliability, operational efficiency, and measurable customer outcomes.

This is not a feature factory role. You are responsible for setting the direction that delights our customers and grows MCIM’s reach.

You will operate at the intersection of customer need, technical feasibility, and business impact, driving clarity, alignment, and execution across cross-functional teams. While MCIM is built on Salesforce and operates within a sophisticated SaaS ecosystem, success in this role depends on strong product management fundamentals: discovery, prioritization, Agile leadership, and outcome-driven thinking. Salesforce experience is valuable. Strong SaaS product management capability is essential.

We are building the operating system for mission-critical facilities. This role helps define what comes next.

What You’ll Do

Own Product Strategy & Outcomes

Define and drive product strategy for key areas of the MCIM platform. Align roadmap decisions with customer needs, company growth objectives, and measurable business outcomes.

Lead Customer Discovery & Voice of Customer

Engage deeply with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders to uncover unmet needs. Translate real-world operational challenges into clear, validated product opportunities.

Prioritize with Discipline

Own backlog prioritization and roadmap sequencing. Make tradeoff decisions grounded in customer value, revenue impact, technical feasibility, and team capacity. Balance innovation with execution.

Drive Agile Execution

Partner closely with engineering in Agile ceremonies (design iterations, planning, refinement, sprint reviews, retros). Ensure requirements are clear, acceptance criteria are defined, and teams are set up to deliver with focus and predictability.

Be the Cross-Functional Connector

Serve as the central communication bridge across engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success. Ensure alignment on priorities, release timing, positioning, and adoption strategy.

Own the Full Product Lifecycle

From discovery to launch to iteration — you are accountable for the performance and adoption of what we ship. This includes defining success metrics and using data to continuously improve.

Support Go-to-Market & Adoption

Collaborate with marketing and sales to define positioning, messaging, and enablement materials. Ensure customer success teams are equipped to drive adoption and measurable value realization.

What Great Looks Like

You think in outcomes, not features.
You can clearly articulate the “why” behind what we are building.
You make hard prioritization decisions and stand behind them.
You are comfortable operating in structured Agile environments.
You can move seamlessly between executive conversations and engineering detail.
You are comfortable in SaaS — recurring revenue, product adoption, usage metrics, and retention matter to you.

Experience

5+ years of experience in SaaS product management.
Proven experience owning a roadmap and delivering products through the full lifecycle.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with cross-functional teams.
Experience with Salesforce-based platforms or AppExchange products is valuable but not required.
Experience with Agentic and AI product development is valuable but not required
Exposure to mission-critical operations, infrastructure management, EAM/CMMS/DCIM/ITSM environments is helpful but not mandatory.

Skills

Strong prioritization and decision-making capability.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to translate customer pain points into clear product requirements.
Comfort interpreting usage data, financial metrics, and customer feedback to inform roadmap decisions.
Experience collaborating with engineering teams on scalable SaaS solutions.
Experienced in working with design to iterate on mockups or visual mockups.

Education

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Salesforce certifications are welcome but not required.

The pay range for this role is:
145,000 - 170,000 USD per year(Remote)

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (Remote, 4-day week)
descriptionText:
Stack Influence is a VC-funded creator marketplace app connecting eCommerce brands with everyday social media users. We are a high-growth, remote-first startup that offers a flexible 4-day work week.

You will report directly to the CTO and play a central role across Product, Engineering, and Operations. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager with a strong technical background to deliver both strategy and execution.

Salary is between $150k–225k USD with equity potential.

Responsibilities:

Own the product roadmap and delivery from ideation to launch, ensuring alignment with company goals and metrics.
Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and Quality Assurance to define requirements, manage sprints, and ensure timely, high-quality releases.
Write detailed product specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria with technical depth (APIs, data models, analytics).
Analyze product data, design experiments, and use insights to prioritize features and improve business performance.
Lead discovery efforts with users, stakeholders, and market research to validate opportunities.
Monitor post-launch performance, gather feedback, and iterate on product improvements.

Qualifications:

5+ years experience as a Product Manager.
2+ years experience in a Software Engineering or Data Science role.
Technical proficiency with APIs, data models, and SQL.
Proven success delivering products in fast-paced, data-driven environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of articulating technical details to non-technical stakeholders.
